The '''Adana system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adana/Legends|Adana]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Faust/Legends|Faust]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
